posts.name: Inferock
posts.tagline: Serverless inference, with credits back for failed calls.
posts.description: Get free signup credits to use all available models on Inferock. Bring your own keys: run your OpenAI, Claude or Gemini accounts, see where calls fail and what they cost, and get credits back on eligible failed calls. Serverless: pay-per-token LLM inference. Get signup credits to start using.

posts.name: Pancake
posts.tagline: The Vercel for GTM
posts.description: Pancake is the Vercel for GTM. It gives you the building blocks to deploy any go-to-market idea from your favorite AI agent, such as Claude or Codex: a GTM Brain, sending infrastructure, and 40+ data providers and enrichment, all accessible through one MCP connection.

posts.name: Retriever AI
posts.tagline: Free AI browser agent: find leads, reach out, apply to jobs
posts.description: Retriever is a free AI browser agent that finishes work across websites. Ask it to find leads and send outreach, shortlist TikTok and Instagram creators for your next campaign, or apply to jobs. Run tasks in your own Chrome browser or in cloud browsers hosted by rtrvr. It beats OpenAI, Anthropic, and Muse on accuracy, runs 5x faster, and costs 300x less.

posts.name: AdAnt 2.0
posts.tagline: Muse for Social Media Marketing
posts.description: AdAnt AI is your proactive, 24/7 social media marketing team. The Strategist researches your niche on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and Meta Ads and writes content strategies that work. The Creator turns every strategy into a batch of videos. The Analyst listens on X and Reddit for conversations worth joining. The Manager plans the calendar and posts. Built on the strategies our founding team used to generate 100M+ organic views and cut paid acquisition costs by 60% on average.

posts.name: daily.dev
posts.tagline: Where agents discover what's next
posts.description: daily.dev is where millions of developers find out what's next. Now your agent can too. Connect Claude, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client to read personalized feeds, search posts, learn from discussions, save bookmarks and tune your feed. In addition, plugin marketplace and apps ecosystem. YOUR AGENTS CAN READ daily.dev NOW!!

posts.name: Tiden
posts.tagline: Intent verification for coding agents
posts.description: Tiden verifies your coding agents built what you actually asked for. Most checks run inside the session that wrote the code, so the tests agree with it by construction. Tiden keeps your intent as requirements that branch and merge like code, and checks every change against that record. The verdict comes from tests run in your environment; no model grades the diff. You decide what merges, and production errors trace back to the release. Works beside Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot.

posts.name: Microsoft Maia 300
posts.tagline: Microsoft’s own AI chip, headed to multi-gigawatts
posts.description: Maia 300 is Microsoft’s next-generation AI inference platform, announced Oct 12, 2026. Per Microsoft, it’s built for long-context reasoning, low-latency conversation, and agents, with 8 HBM4 stacks, TSMC N2P compute chiplets, and 96-accelerator racks. Microsoft claims 40% more tokens per megawatt. Production starts in 2027, and Azure Maia scales to multi-gigawatt deployments, becoming the main inference system for Microsoft’s products.

posts.name: Reason
posts.tagline: A state-of-the-art coding agent for cost efficiency
posts.description: Reason is the best coding agent, in the cloud or locally. Give it a task and it writes code, runs tests and opens a pull request. Use Reason from the Mac app, terminal, web or Slack, with your choice of models and connected subscriptions. Start free on your own computer. Our published GPT-6 Astra evaluation scores 65.1 on the Coding Agent Index vs Codex’s 62.5, at 22% lower cost per solved task.

posts.name: AirJelly
posts.tagline: Your Proactive, Self-Organizing Second Brain
posts.description: AirJelly is an always-on desktop AI agent that proactively captures your intent, organizes your tasks, and gets things done. By observing your on-screen activities, it knows who you are and what you're working on. It doesn't just spot your to-dos — it foresees what's next and acts. It also tracks your personal interactions, so you'll never miss a follow-up or forget a promise. Everything in your life is managed by AirJelly — freeing your time for what AI can't do, or simply for you to enjoy.

posts.name: Specreel
posts.tagline: Product demos that update themselves
posts.description: Paste your app's URL and Specreel walks it in a real browser, turning your key flows into narrated, shareable demos. Already on Playwright? It renders them from your test traces on every green build, so a demo can't go stale. Open-source CLI + hosted Cloud.

posts.name: Table Canon
posts.tagline: Automated notes, searchable history, prep ideas for GMs
posts.description: Focus on the session, not note taking. Simplify your prep time with a searchable memory-bank of what happened at your table. Table Canon turns uploaded game-night audio into a recap, outline, entity dossiers, searchable index, and prep ideas for tabletop RPG game masters. Memory evolves each session. No sign up required to get started, 6 hours of audio upload free! Message me that you saw the launch on Product Hunt and I’ll credit your account with an extra 10 hours.

posts.name: Apple HomePod mini 2
posts.tagline: Apple's tiny smart speaker, now built for Siri AI
posts.description: HomePod mini 2 is Apple's next-generation compact smart speaker, built for a more personal Siri AI experience coming in a future update. It brings rich 360-degree sound, new colors, and Sound Glow lighting that responds to your music. Enjoy improved Mac audio, multiroom playback, and surround sound with Apple TV 4K, plus hands-free smart home control. Starting at $149, with preorders open now and availability from October 30.

posts.name: Mira Tours
posts.tagline: AI Walking Tour Guide
posts.description: Mira is your AI tour guide. Walking audio tours, anywhere in the world: chat to build your own, or just start walking and hear the story of the places around you.

posts.name: Rambox
posts.tagline: Ready-to-use workspaces as you switch tasks and contexts
posts.description: A major Rambox redesign focused on making everyday work simpler, faster and easier to navigate. The new interface reduces friction and the number of clicks needed to move between apps, workspaces, tasks and contexts, while a redesigned onboarding experience makes Rambox easier to set up and understand. This release also adds faster access to what you need, improved tabs and context persistence, Unified Search, Quick View, Command Center and new focus tools.

posts.name: Make0 Brain
posts.tagline: A memory store that works across all of your AI agents.
posts.description: Make0 Brain is a personal memory store that works across ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible AI tools. AI agents can read and write to this memory and be in sync with your personal context. It is like dropbox but for memories - specifically built for agents to use. You can easily build your brain in just 2 minutes by importing your conversations from Claude, ChatGPT and even dropping your markdown files and documents.

posts.name: Cloud Releases
posts.tagline: Every AWS, Azure, GCP and Cloudflare update in one feed
posts.description: 🔥 Cloud providers ship thousands of updates a year across separate blogs and changelogs. Cloud Releases puts AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and Cloudflare in one feed. Follow only the services you run, and spot retirements before they break something.

posts.name: Kugel 3.5
posts.tagline: ext-to-speech that beats any other Model out there
posts.description: Kugel 3.5 beats four leading TTS models on 8 of 9 tests. It gets short words wrong at half the rate of the next-best model, reads long numbers exactly right 97.1% of the time and supports IPA. 5.25 cents a minute. Not on Kugel? Three lines to production.

posts.name: EditUI
posts.tagline: Point at your UI. Tell your coding agent what to change.
posts.description: Explaining to cursor/claude code/codex UI changes: spacing is off, this card is too tall, that CTA is too loud, mobile looks weird.....is annoying. With EditUI you open your actual app/website in Chrome, click anything, leave a quick instruction, keep reviewing, then send the whole batch to Claude Code at once. No repo setup. Just a Chrome extension. Free and open source. No signup, no backend.

posts.name: Epherem
posts.tagline: Find login and database flaws in your AI-built app
posts.description: Epherem is a free source code security scanner for apps built with AI. It checks for common security issues involving authentication, database access, exposed API keys and vulnerable packages. Upload a ZIP or connect a GitHub repository to scan your app. Findings include plain-English explanations, suggested fixes and prompts you can paste into Claude Code, Lovable or Cursor. Reports can also be exported for review with your AI coding assistant, including issues the scanner couldn't verify.

posts.name: Hindsight 1.0 + Memlake
posts.tagline: Open source memory for AI agents to learn from experience
posts.description: Hindsight is open-source memory that lets AI agents learn from experience, #1 on every dataset of the Agent Memory Benchmark. Today it's 1.0, and the API is a promise. We're also launching Hindsight Memlake, a storage engine written in Rust that keeps agent memory in object storage: 100M memories at under 100 ms p99, with no database, consensus cluster or leader. Self-host it free, start on Hindsight Cloud with free credits, or run it in your own cloud with Enterprise.

posts.name: Winq
posts.tagline: Control your Mac with a look and a wink
posts.description: Gaze focus switching: look at a window and it becomes the active one. Per-eye wink clicks: left wink and right wink are separate actions. Face-gesture shortcuts: map gestures to the actions you use most. Notch island: a small live indicator in the notch area shows what Winq detected. No extra hardware: it works with your Mac’s built-in camera, with a short guided calibration. Private by design: all face tracking runs on your Mac, and no video leaves the device.

posts.name: Exodus for Google Cloud Run
posts.tagline: Upgrade any app to Cloud Run, with your coding agent
posts.description: Cloud Run is Google's managed platform: no servers to look after, new copies in seconds under load, a bill only while your code works. Exodus takes your app there with your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor): it checks the app on your machine, shows what you pay today and on Cloud Run and what to change, by 50+ playbooks from real moves. Then the agent makes the move, task by task, or designs a new app for Cloud Run. Free and open source. Try it on your repo today.

posts.name: SupoClip
posts.tagline: Open-source AI clipper: long videos into viral shorts
posts.description: SupoClip turns long videos into vertical, captioned shorts. Paste a YouTube link or upload a file: AI transcribes it, picks the strongest 15–60s moments and scores each for virality, then crops 9:16 around the speaker and burns in word-synced captions and a hook title. Trim, split, merge and export for TikTok, Reels and Shorts. No watermarks. Open source (AGPL-3.0): self-host it free, or use the web app, iPhone app, REST API or MCP server.

posts.name: Nimble
posts.tagline: SOTA Decision Model
posts.description: Today, we are announcing Nimble-v4 and Nimble-v4-max which are pushing the frontier of decision models, outperforming Jev and other variants. On Decision Index public scores, our nimble-v4-max model and nimble-v4 models score +10.5 and +5.74 against Jev 1.13, making nimble-v4-max a top performing model. Beyond benchmarks, we have done a lot of internal evals, and see big improvements: 43% fewer mistakes than Jev, +50pp on model routing decisions, and so on. Try for free: console.bespokelabs.ai

posts.name: Screenwell.ai
posts.tagline: An AI interviewer that runs your first-round screening
posts.description: Screenwell screens every applicant for you: Luna holds a short screening call through a link in your job ad, on Google Meet or Teams, and hands you a ranked shortlist with scores and quotes. 14 days free, no card needed.

posts.name: Acyclic
posts.tagline: Rapid agent swarms for any agentic workflow
posts.description: Hand Acyclic a task from the CLI, the dashboard, or a coding agent over MCP. It splits the work across many agents, each in its own instant fork of the workspace, and merges the results, so long agentic workflows finish in a fraction of the time. Bring your own model keys.

posts.name: OpenCouncil
posts.tagline: Voice rooms where your team and AIs debate together
posts.description: Put GPT, Gemini, Grok and your own agents in one live voice room with your team. They answer, push back on each other and never talk over you. A Scribe writes the decisions. Make the room public and anyone can listen, chat or take the stage. Works in your browser and Google Meet. Free to start: 2,000 credits, no card.

posts.name: SlashDocs by Razorpay
posts.tagline: Self-hosted collaboration layer for agent-written HTML
posts.description: SlashDocs is a self-hosted, open-source collaboration hub for AI agents. Agents publish real, interactive HTML documents, not plain text, and your team comments directly on the live doc. The agent reads that feedback and updates the same file in place, no new file every round, no feedback scattered across Slack or email. Self-hosted, agent-agnostic (works over MCP with any agent), and already powering about half of all documents created inside Razorpay.

posts.name: RoleFit
posts.tagline: Tailor every job application without starting from scratch
posts.description: Hiring is slow, competition is tough, and tailoring every application takes time. RoleFit helps job seekers do more with less effort. Powered by Gemini AI, it analyzes job descriptions, identifies strengths and skill gaps, and creates personalized, ATS-friendly resumes, cover letters, and LinkedIn outreach messages. Refine documents with an AI copilot, export PDF/DOCX files, and track applications in one place. Built on Google Cloud Run.

posts.name: CSuite
posts.tagline: All-in-one suite for AI content creation, fully private.
posts.description: All-in-one AI suite for text, images, audio, and video — local or cloud models, on your machine, fully private. One-time payment. No login. No subscriptions.

posts.name: Keysi
posts.tagline: See every shortcut of the app you're in
posts.description: Hold ⌘ in any Mac app to see every keyboard shortcut, read live from its menus. Click a row to run it. Free, no time limit. Keysi Pro ($14.99 once) teaches the ones you keep missing: a quiet reminder, spaced-repetition drills, and "New" marks after updates.

posts.name: NoteHouse
posts.tagline: Private lending, without the paperwork headache.
posts.description: NoteHouse makes private lending easier. Whether you’re lending to family, helping a friend, or managing multiple loans, you shouldn’t need spreadsheets to keep track of everything. Create loan agreements, set repayment terms, track interest and payments, and see exactly what’s owed. Both borrowers and lenders stay on the same page, with all their documents and payment history in one place.

posts.name: WriterzRoom
posts.tagline: Governed multi-agent AI content for regulated industries
posts.description: Enterprise Content Intelligence platform. A multi-agent pipeline governed by vertical controls, template schema, and brand voice execution. Every generation is structured, validated, and review-ready before delivery. Runs fully serverless on Google Cloud Run.

posts.name: Spinachi AI
posts.tagline: Your family's personal health manager on WhatsApp
posts.description: Your health, finally in one place. Forward your lab reports on WhatsApp. Spinachi sorts them for you and your family. See where you stand, how it's changing, and when your next test is due. No app. Never a diagnosis.

posts.name: PixLate
posts.tagline: Translate documents. Preserve artwork and layout.
posts.description: PixLate translates PDFs, scans, and illustrated pages while preserving their artwork and layout. It combines AI translation with side-by-side review, correction tools, background processing, and PDF export. Projects stay on your device with pay-as-you-go credits.

posts.name: Etchv
posts.tagline: invisible forensic watermarks in images, PDFs and videos
posts.description: Etchv embeds invisible forensic watermarks into images, PDFs, and short videos that survive screenshots, format changes, and compression. https://etchv.com/#try-it Key Features • A unique forensic watermark, written into the pixels by a neural net model, and made to survive resizing, cropping and compression. • Flexible Integration: Supports a direct developer API alongside official SDKs • No-Code Automation: Integrates with Zapier, n8n, and Make. • Live Demo: https://etchv.com/demo/trace

posts.name: Blade
posts.tagline: Find your first customers hiding in your inbox
posts.description: You’ve spent years meeting people. A lot of those relationships are now buried in your inbox. Blade helps you find them again. Filter by how often you’ve emailed, when you last connected, and whether someone’s outside your company. Then send each person an individual email through your own Gmail. Whether you’re launching something, asking for feedback, or inviting people to an event, you’re starting with people who already know you.

posts.name: Orbora
posts.tagline: Create personalized guided audio: meditation, breath, ASMR
posts.description: Orbora generates audio talks tailored to you: guided meditations, breathwork, ASMR and short wisdom talks. Follow a guided path that walks you through what you need. Then shape the result: voice, length, tone, background sound and themes. AI writes and voices each talk from your choices. Save favorites, build your own library, and listen offline.

posts.name: Elocuenti
posts.tagline: Agentic commerce: sell on WhatsApp and AI assistants
posts.description: Elocuenti is agentic commerce for WhatsApp and AI assistants. Your customers buy by chatting: on WhatsApp with your AI agent, or in ChatGPT and Claude, where their assistant searches your real catalog, builds the cart and places the order. Your agent learns from every customer, follows up, recovers carts and runs campaigns that send conversions back to Meta Ads.

posts.name: AURORA Lifeline
posts.tagline: Know who a cyclone will cut off, before the roads close
posts.description: Turns the official IMD cyclone bulletin into a district plan: which PHCs, hospitals and villages will lose road access, how likely, when, and what to move first. Gemini reads the bulletin, 1,000+ WeatherNext and ECMWF storm futures run over every road, and code inserts every number. Officers approve everything. Open source, misses published.

posts.name: T-Scriptor
posts.tagline: Be in the lecture. T-Scriptor takes the notes.
posts.description: T-Scriptor transcribes your lectures on your mac, So the audio never leaves it. After class it writes the notes: key concepts, what's due and the papers your professor mentioned. Before the exam it pulls the whole course together. The Mac app's live and you can download it on https://t-scriptor.app, the Iphone app is in Beta.

posts.name: FamRelay
posts.tagline: Share facts between AI assistants — only what you approve
posts.description: AI assistants are islands. Yours knows the plumber's coming Tuesday; your wife's knows nothing, and you're back to being the messenger. It's a neutral relay layer between AI assistants. Tell your assistant to share specific facts with specific people — "let Sam know the plumber's coming 8 to 10" — and their assistant picks it up. Nothing moves until you approve what's sent. It also works solo: add the connector to two or more assistants you own — Claude at work, ChatGPT at home — and relay facts

posts.name: CraveLens
posts.tagline: See it. Crave it. Get it.
posts.description: CraveLens is a Chrome extension that uses on-device AI to identify food in supported videos and selected webpage regions, then prepare personalized Swiggy carts for your review.

posts.name: Payload Peek
posts.tagline: Catch Webhooks. Inspect Payloads. Generate TypeScript.
posts.description: A live webhook inbox for developers. Inspect HTTP requests, explore JSON payloads, and turn real events into TypeScript interfaces or Zod schemas. All in your browser, with no setup or account required.

posts.name: Dashrendr
posts.tagline: Build dashboards visually, embed them anywhere
posts.description: Dashrendr is a visual dashboard builder made for embedding in your SaaS. Drag charts onto a grid and have a dashboard ready in minutes, then get data in two ways: connect a data source, or POST JSON from your backend. Your app already knows who's logged in, so each customer only sees their own data, with no row-level security to set up. And when someone wants a chart changed, anyone on the team can do it in the builder, no code or new deployment needed.

posts.name: Diagramly
posts.tagline: Sketch systems at the speed you think
posts.description: Hand-drawn diagrams and cheat sheets you can type or describe. Write Client -> API -> DB, or ask the AI, and it's drawn and laid out. Six looks, from paper to blueprint to neon. Present as slides, embed in docs, export PNG, SVG or PDF. Free, no sign-up.

posts.name: LegacyFixer
posts.tagline: Python dependency security scans with optional fix PRs
posts.description: Compared with Dependabot and Renovate, LegacyFixer focuses on security-first scanning of Python dependencies. It reports vulnerability findings even when an automated fix is not appropriate, and creates a fix pull request only when its policy and validation checks allow it. Each scan produces an explicit outcome, including detect-only (NO_ACTION) when no fix PR is created. LegacyFixer runs as a GitHub App on Google Cloud Run.

posts.name: Halvsy for iPhone
posts.tagline: Scan any receipt, tap who had what, and everyone's square
posts.description: Halvsy turns a photo of the bill into a group balance, now on iPhone. It reads every line, tax and tip, and checks them against the printed total. You tap who had what, tax and tip are split in proportion to each person's order, and every share lands in the group. Friends join with a QR code, each group keeps its own currency, and settling up goes through the payment app you already use. No ads and no daily limit on expenses.

posts.name: Сectric
posts.tagline: Free equipment & asset maintenance tracker
posts.description: Cectric is a lightweight, 100% free CMMS/EAM app built for tracking industrial maintenance, HVAC, UPS units, generators, data centers, and technical assets. • 100% free with no ads, paywalls, or user limits • Native multi-language support (23 languages out of the box) • Fast service logging, and issue tracking • Built for field engineers, maintenance teams, and individual users • Available on iOS and Android

posts.name: WatchLux Watch Faces
posts.tagline: Animated AI-art watch faces for Apple Watch and Wear OS
posts.description: Give your wrist a new look. Explore the WatchLux collection for Apple Watch (watchOS) and Wear OS, with AI-crafted animated artwork and themed watch faces. Free download, free designs and paid premium options. Designs and animation vary by platform.

posts.name: Vetoxi
posts.tagline: SEO + AEO on AutoPilot
posts.description: An autonomous agent that ingests your GSC maps the competitive landscape, personas and executes content changes ~ 24/7, without human intervention so you can focus on your Product :)

posts.name: Agent-Native
posts.tagline: Open-source framework for building agentic apps
posts.description: Agent-Native is an open-source TypeScript framework for building agentic apps: AI agents that come with their own rich UI. The agent and the UI share the same actions, data, and state, so anything you can do in the app, the agent can do too. Define an action once and it powers your UI, agent, HTTP API, CLI, MCP server, and A2A endpoint. Auth, permissions, and real-time collaboration are built in, and it works with any AI model. Build locally and deploy anywhere.

posts.name: Vibely
posts.tagline: Create stunning web and mobile apps in minutes with AI.
posts.description: Vibely is an AI-powered app builder that turns your ideas into real web and mobile apps through conversation. Describe what you want to build, and Vibely helps you go from idea to working product without starting from scratch. Built for founders, creators, and small teams who want to build and launch faster.

posts.name: OpenSVG.dev
posts.tagline: 321k+ Free SVG Icons, Ready for Designers & Developers.
posts.description: Free 321k+ open-source, customizable icons and svg tools for developers and designers in one place. Customize styles live, copy, download or export clean code for your projects, and sync collections across the web, Figma, Chrome, and VS Code.

posts.name: Reel Crew
posts.tagline: Turn brand archives into reels with production memory
posts.description: Reel Crew turns a brand's existing creative archive into a video production system that remembers. Gemini + Google ADK query production memory through ClickHouse MCP, plan a call sheet, and hand it to a deterministic renderer. Explore a recorded walkthrough of a completed run, hosted directly on Google Cloud Run. The public demo is a replay; fresh live generation is not currently available in this launch experience. Open source (Apache-2.0).

posts.name: Grippi
posts.tagline: Blend your ad platforms into one dashboard, automatically
posts.description: Grippi unifies your ad and ecommerce performance across Meta, Google, Shopify, TikTok, and Amazon into one dashboard. It delivers automated, plain-language insights and anomaly alerts, so you catch a spend spike or CPA jump before your client does. Agencies get a Masterview of every client with status labels for at-a-glance monitoring. Built for marketing teams and agencies who need to stay on top of performance across multiple channels without manual reporting.

posts.name: Kerno 1.0
posts.tagline: The AI Runtime Backend QA Engineer
posts.description: Kerno v1 is our biggest upgrade yet, a complete AI Backend QA Engineer. It maps your codebase, learns how your app works, and gets sharper with every run. It now tests your whole backend, from full user flows and live security checks to background jobs, queues, MCP servers and AWS serverless. Bugs get caught inside your agent's session before you open a PR, then re-checked on every PR in CI.

posts.name: Aurio
posts.tagline: Spending, shared bills and net worth, with transparent AI
posts.description: Aurio brings your spending, shared expenses (partner, family, friends), budgets and net worth into one app for iPhone and web. Import statements, log Apple Pay purchases with Shortcuts or scan receipts; no bank connection needed. Ask your finances in plain language and get answers with sources, plus a per-feature table of exactly what the AI sees. Freelancers in Spain get VAT and income tax estimates. Informational only: it never files taxes or moves money. Free to start.

posts.name: Wazam
posts.tagline: Shazam for identifying movie/show clips on Reels, TikTok etc
posts.description: Find the source of videos online, especially movies & shows, simply by sharing the link with Wazam, an AI agent built to help you have fun. Skip the stress of Googling, scouring comments, screenshotting... Just like Shazam magically identifies songs you like, Wazam identifies shows/movies with just as much magic. Share what you Wazam with friends or save it for later, so when you're looking for something to watch, you don't spend 30 minutes browsing Netflix only to give up in disappointment.

posts.name: Narron
posts.tagline: Manage your brand perception in AI Universe
posts.description: Narron is an AI-native martech platform that helps marketing teams and agencies understand the conversations shaping their brand, spot opportunities to stand out from competitors, and create campaigns for the right channels. We're building a connected workflow: Sentinel finds market signals, PR Factory prepares content and coordinates distribution, and Lens measures how AI sees your brand—informing what to do next. Lens is available now; PR Factory has pilot access; Sentinel is in development.

posts.name: Clipboard Manager - ClipBox
posts.tagline: Your clipboard history, synced across Apple devices
posts.description: ClipBox brings your clipboard history together across Mac, iPhone and iPad. Save text, links, images and snippets; find them with advanced search; restore deleted clips for 30 days; and sync with iCloud. On Mac, queue clips and paste them in order.

posts.name: DigitalOcean Insights
posts.tagline: One place to monitor your infrastructure and agents
posts.description: DigitalOcean Insights is an observability product that brings metrics, logs, and traces into one place for your infrastructure, applications, and AI agents. Built-in integrations send telemetry with no installation or instrumentation, and it runs on OpenTelemetry. Includes dashboards, explorers, PromQL queries, alerts, and an API. Covers DOKS, App Platform, and the agent stack. Free during public preview, with charging expected at GA

posts.name: Simple Agent Store
posts.tagline: Dead simple storage for your AI agents
posts.description: Save notes, todos, contacts, and JSON with one AI agent. Retrieve them with another. Simple Agent Store gives your connected agents one shared store via MCP, with a web viewer to inspect your data. Use managed Cloud or self-host the Apache-2.0 core. Five operations: put, get, list, search, delete. Your agents handle language; the store keeps the objects you ask them to save.

posts.name: Runnway.co.uk
posts.tagline: Your idea. Ready for take-off.
posts.description: Turn your idea into a real digital product. Runnway is a London-based startup studio designing and building apps, AI tools and software ready for take-off.

posts.name: Printery
posts.tagline: Design brochures, catalogs and reports in your browser
posts.description: Printery is a browser-based layout app for brochures, catalogs and reports. Flow text across pages, reuse styles, collect feedback and export PDFs with print controls. Start from a template, a blank document or your Figma designs.

posts.name: Meowslim
posts.tagline: A cozy, ad-free Quran and prayer app with a cat mascot
posts.description: Meowslim is a Quran and prayer companion with no ads. Read the full 30-juz Quran with tafsir and verse-by-verse murottal, get prayer times and adhan alarms for your location, find the qibla, and count dhikr on a digital tasbih. A worship tracker with daily streaks and XP helps you keep a routine, and Musa the cat keeps you company. Free on Android, with desktop apps for Windows, macOS and Linux. In English and Indonesian.

posts.name: Paperfrogs HQ
posts.tagline: We build tools for things that matter.
posts.description: Paperfrogs is a Dhaka-based venture capital and company-building platform. We back and build infrastructure, security products, developer tools, and research-led ideas.

posts.name: Ziffysign
posts.tagline: e-Signatures with flat pricing and unlimited documents
posts.description: Ziffysign is a secure e-signature platform built for small & medium businesses. Send contracts, agreements, and other documents for legally binding signatures, track signing progress, and keep a complete audit trail - all in one place. With unlimited documents and signatures and support for up to 50 team members, Ziffysign gives growing businesses a straightforward alternative to expensive e-signature tools.

posts.name: TillTech
posts.tagline: Simple UK till for shops, cafes & takeaways with Loyalty
posts.description: Sell in store, on your own online shop, on the Nearbies marketplace and over the phone with caller ID — fulfil by pickup or delivery and reward loyal customers, all run from one cloud backoffice. POS software for UK shops, takeaways, food vans and home businesses, from £12/month. Start a free trial today.

posts.name: AcceptDeck
posts.tagline: Client sign-off for Jira, without giving clients Jira access
posts.description: AcceptDeck makes client approvals simpler for teams using Jira. Share a review link with clients, collect approvals or change requests, and keep decisions tracked in Jira — without asking clients to navigate Jira themselves. Built for agencies, consultancies, and teams delivering work to clients.

posts.name: Hoodli
posts.tagline: Your local neighborhood all in one place.
posts.description: What you can do on Hoodli: 🏷️ Buy and sell with neighbors, and grab free stuff from curb alerts before it's gone 🛠️ Find local pros your neighbors actually recommend 📅 See what's happening: events, garage sales and places to explore around town 🏠 Find housing and jobs close to home 💬 Ask your neighbors: recommendations, lost pets, questions about town It's free to join, and your email stays private. Neighbors message each other right on Hoodli.

posts.name: Orbit
posts.tagline: Your projects, tasks, and context together on your Mac
posts.description: Orbit keeps tasks, notes, documents, files, links, and repositories in one local workspace for macOS. See GitHub/GitLab activity and give AI clients project context through MCP

posts.name: GreenCheckmark - Digitally signed photo
posts.tagline: Just like signed PDF files, you can verify their originality
posts.description: *** AI slops are obscuring authentic photos and videos. *** GreenCheckmark allows creators to make verifiable content to raise the trust level. 1) Sellers/Realtors: Verifiable photos make their listing stand-out. What you see is what you REALLY get. 2) Newsrooms: Minimize the need to send reporters to the field to take trusted photos, which costs money & time. 3) Citizen Journalism: Assure their viewers that the photos are authentic, captured directly from camera, and unmodified by human or AI.

posts.name: ScreenForge
posts.tagline: Record, auto-zoom & edit pro screen videos on Mac and Linux
posts.description: Auto-polished screen recordings plus a real timeline editor, in one native app for Mac and Linux. Hit record, talk it through, and get a finished video: zooms that follow your clicks and typing, a smooth cursor and clean backgrounds. Your voice lands on its own track, so you can split it, trim the ums, move or mute it without touching the video. Export MP4, ProRes, GIF or WebM up to 4K. Written 100% in Rust, open source, GPU-rendered, free to record and edit.

posts.name: rsync.ai
posts.tagline: Describe a data pipeline in plain English
posts.description: rsync.ai moves data between databases, warehouses and APIs (batch or CDC), models it with scheduled SQL, and turns it into dashboards and Slack alerts. Free to try at app.rsync.ai. The pipeline and SQL-model core is source-available to self-host.

posts.name: TextMatchCut
posts.tagline: Text Match Cut
posts.description: Free text match cut maker. Type a word, get the viral newspaper highlight effect, and download it as video. No signup, no watermark, runs in your browser.

posts.name: PickleballDraw
posts.tagline: Review serves, dinks, and drives, frame by frame
posts.description: PickleballDraw helps players and coaches review serves, dinks, drives, and footwork on iPhone and iPad. Slow clips down, step through each frame, draw on the video, and compare two takes side by side. Add voice notes and tags, then share annotated clips with a coach or partner. One purchase includes every tool. No subscription, ads, or account. Videos and analysis stay on your device unless you choose to share them.

posts.name: eksis
posts.tagline: Schedule posts, answer comments and DMs, automate replies
posts.description: eksis is a social media tool for creators, small businesses, and agencies. Connect Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Pinterest, Bluesky, and DEV, then schedule posts from one composer, answer comments and DMs in one inbox, and set rules that reply to a comment or send a DM when a keyword shows up. AI caption drafts and reply suggestions are included. The Free plan covers one account; Starter is $4 a month for 20.

posts.name: Nova Video
posts.tagline: Video By AIGC, Easy, Professional-grade
posts.description: Generate professional video content with advanced AI models

posts.name: BlinkMate
posts.tagline: macOS menu bar reminder to rest your eyes regularly
posts.description: BlinkMate is a native macOS menu bar app that helps protect your eyes with gentle reminders to take breaks. Follow the 20-20-20 rule recommended by eye care professionals.

posts.name: Jarvis Live
posts.tagline: Open-source voice AI that talks back and runs your agents
posts.description: Jarvis is a realtime voice AI you talk to like a person. It answers out loud in about a second, searches the web and shows live cards. When a task needs a computer, it says so and hands it to Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity or Hermes on your own machine, then reads you the result. Talk face to face with a live avatar. Self-host the open-source app (MIT), or link the free desktop app to Jarvis Cloud and use it from iPhone, Apple Watch, Android and the web.

posts.name: HireClover
posts.tagline: Remote tech jobs, straight from company career pages
posts.description: Remote jobs at AI and tech companies straight from their hiring systems, each with the countries you can work from. Filter by role, stack, level, country.

posts.name: Quiet Digest
posts.tagline: Your saved links, as one calm e-book on your Kindle
posts.description: Quiet Digest turns the articles, newsletters and YouTube videos you save during the day into one calm EPUB, delivered to your Kindle at the hour you pick. Each piece is stripped of ads, pop-ups and sidebars and rewritten for an e-ink screen. Videos come back as text. Every issue has a dated cover, a contents page with reading times, and a closing page with one line worth keeping from each piece. Free: a weekly issue. Pro: daily delivery and YouTube.

posts.name: Resume Job Match by AllthingsPM
posts.tagline: Every open PM role, scored 0 to 100 against your resume
posts.description: Add your resume and search live product manager openings from across the market. Every role gets a 0 to 100 fit score with a one-line reason, so you apply to the jobs you can actually win instead of scrolling hundreds of listings. Free to use, and the resume is optional.

posts.name: Pancakeswap Clone Script
posts.tagline: The Foundation for Your Next DeFi Business
posts.description: The Foundation for Your Next DeFi Business starts with right exchange infrastructure. PancakeSwap Clone Script Development helps businesses create a decentralized exchange with smart contract integration, liquidity pools, token swapping, wallet connectivity, and transaction workflows. For entrepreneur and startups entering DeFi, it offers a practical foundation to shape their own trading platform, define a business model, and create new opportunities within the decentralized finance ecosystem.

posts.name: BlinkMate
posts.tagline: macOS menu bar reminder to rest your eyes regularly
posts.description: BlinkMate is a native macOS menu bar app that helps protect your eyes with gentle reminders to take breaks. Follow the 20-20-20 rule recommended by eye care professionals.

posts.name: SubzKrib
posts.tagline: Never forget a subscription or free trial again
posts.description: SubzKrib helps you track subscriptions, free trials, upcoming renewals, and recurring spending in one simple dashboard.

posts.name: TillTech
posts.tagline: Affordable UK till system for small shops and cafes
posts.description: TillTech is a UK-built till system for independent shops, cafes and takeaways. Ring up sales on Windows, Android or iPhone, with the Windows till working offline. Add customer loyalty, online ordering with card payments, table service and kitchen screens, stock and staff tools. Customers collect and spend points in the free Nearbies app.

posts.name: FloatTimer+
posts.tagline: Timers, counters and stopwatches that float over any app
posts.description: FloatTimer+ shows countdown timers, tally counters and stopwatches in small windows that stay on top of any app while you cook, train, study or play. Drag each one anywhere, collapse it to a bubble or tuck it to the screen edge, and play, pause or reset it from the overlay. Run as many as you like at once, with sound, vibration or full-screen alerts. Also on Windows. Free shows one overlay at a time with ads; Pro allows several at once and removes ads.

posts.name: Levelrail
posts.tagline: Self-hosted deployment platform: push to git and deploy
posts.description: Push to git, get a running app with TLS, logs, metrics and rollback. Self-hosted, one Go binary, no Kubernetes.

posts.name: Stuon
posts.tagline: Turn studying into a game.
posts.description: Stuon is a gamified study timer that helps students track their study time, build streaks, visualize progress, and stay consistent. Use focused study sessions, heatmaps, goals, analytics, leaderboards, flashcards and more.. all in one place. Instead of just starting a timer, Stuon turns every session into visible progress you can build on over time.

posts.name: Meeba Brain
posts.tagline: AI code debugging with evidence, not guesses
posts.description: AI can give a plausible debugging answer without proving it. Meeba Brain traces your codebase and dependencies, then shows the evidence behind each conclusion — separating Verified, Inferred, and Unknown.

posts.name: Chai UI
posts.tagline: AI-native, open source design system
posts.description: The same UIs built into today's most powerful AI apps, now open source. One interface for every AI model, for React and Vue, running on Fal.ai, OpenRouter or your own engine.

posts.name: Globber
posts.tagline: Block spam calls by pattern, not by number
posts.description: Globber is a free, open-source Android call blocker that screens by pattern — prefixes, wildcards, regex — before your phone rings. Five match types, reject/silence/voicemail actions, block log. No INTERNET permission, no ads, no accounts. 100% on-device. MIT.

posts.name: CardValue.ai
posts.tagline: AI-powered card valuations in seconds.
posts.description: Hey Product Hunt! I'm Sem, and I built CardValue.ai to help you discover what your Pokémon cards are worth. Upload a photo to identify your card, check its market price, and analyze its condition with AI-powered grading insights, all directly in your browser. Whether you're checking a rare pull or going through an old collection, CardValue.ai makes Pokémon card analysis simple. It's completely free, with no subscription needed. I'd love to hear your feedback! Try it at https://cardvalue.ai

posts.name: Resumeize
posts.tagline: Tailor your resume to any job without inventing a thing
posts.description: Most AI resume tools quietly add skills you don't have. Resumeize does the opposite. Paste a job and your resume. Every requirement is matched to a line you actually wrote, and you get two scores: how an ATS reads you and how a recruiter skims you. For the gaps, it asks 3 quick questions instead of making things up, then builds a tailored draft you edit with live scores. Free to check, no account. One-time packs, no subscription.

posts.name: LM-35 AF
posts.tagline: A disposable camera inside Lightmeter, just like 90s
posts.description: Lightmeter is a film camera that lives on your iPhone. Photos get real grain, glow and film colour, built from the raw image, not a filter. New: the LM-35 AF disposable camera. No screen to check, just a roll of film and an hour’s wait for your photos to come back from the lab. It’s also a light meter for real film cameras. Free to download, no sign-up, and your photos never leave your phone.

posts.name: DeskArcade
posts.tagline: Sneak a game into any meeting.
posts.description: A native macOS menu-bar app that drops a transparent arcade of ten micro-games over your real desktop. Press ⌘⌥B, play for 90 seconds, press it againgone. Free, notarized, doesn't touch your real apps.

posts.name: Turf War: Taipei
posts.tagline: A free browser FPS set on the streets of Taipei
posts.description: A free, round-based SWAT vs Militia shooter set in real Taipei landmarks: Ximending, Taipei 101, Memorial Hall. Earn cash, buy guns between rounds, drive scooters, fly a helicopter. 1v1 to 24v24 with bots. Runs in your browser on PC and phone.

posts.name: Collage Maker: Grid Templates
posts.tagline: Photo Frames, Layout, Editor
posts.description: Create beautiful photo collages in seconds. Choose a template or customize your layout, drag and drop photos, adjust spacing, and export in high quality.
